data.desc: Caledonia is a gold production, exploration and development company with its operations focused in Zimbabwe. Caledonia's primary asset is the Blanket Gold Mine - an underground gold mine in the Matabeleland South province, in which the Company currently holds a 64% interest. Over the last decade, the Company has invested in the development of the Blanket Gold Mine. Caledonia is also advancing other gold projects in Zimbabwe including the Bilboes Project, Maligreen Project and the Motapa Project.
